annotations.title: Request a review of a service not yet covered (free; optional paid expedite)

description: Request that UseTested buy and test an agent-economy service (x402 endpoint, MCP server, AI API) we haven't reviewed yet. Free — the listing depends on our testing pipeline and may take a few weeks, and there is no SLA or guaranteed verdict. For a paid expedited first review, set include_testing_expedite_listing=true (requires service_url): we read the endpoint's live x402 price and return an upfront quote — $1.00 rubric fee + the advertised per-call price x 20 probe calls — settled via accept_retest_quote (x402, USDC on Base), which queues a full first review in the next nightly pass.

email_for_notification.description: Optional email address to notify when the test verdict is delivered. Stored with the request only; never required.

include_testing_expedite_listing.description: Also quote a paid expedited first review (requires service_url): $1.00 fee + live advertised price x 20 probe calls, settled via accept_retest_quote. Default false — the free request alone is always recorded.

notes.description: Why this service matters to you (context helps prioritisation)

requestor_id.description: Identity tag for the request ledger. Leave unset for normal use.

service_name.description: Name of the service you want reviewed

service_url.description: Endpoint or landing URL of the service, if known (required for include_testing_expedite_listing)

name: request_review
